Name: Jotham, King of Judah
Summary: Jotham governed Judah while his father Azariah lived apart as a leper, and reigned sixteen years doing right, though the high places were not removed.
KeyStory: Jotham governs for his leprous father and reigns in his stead.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 15:32; 2 Kings 15:38; 2 Chronicles 27:1; 2 Chronicles 27:6; Isaiah 1:1; Isaiah 7:1; Hosea 1:1; Micah 1:1
RelatedPeople: Uzziah, King of Judah; Jerusha, Mother of Jotham; Ahaz, King of Judah; Jerushah, Daughter of Zadok; Isaiah
LifeLesson: Faithfulness in a supporting role is still faithfulness: Jotham served well before he ever wore the crown.
